title: Console: command buttons dump raw JSON instead of returning to page
description: Every command form except on the Sprint page omits the returnTo hidden field. server.ts only issues a 303 back to the page when returnTo is present (safeReturnTo); otherwise it sendJson()s, so in a browser the form submit navigates the window to a raw JSON page. Affects CommandPanel (Global/Settings/Health/Reports), the topbar Refresh button, and project-settings forms. Verified via live POST to /api/commands/sync.status returning content-type application/json. Fix: add returnTo hidden field (Sprint boards.tsx already does this).
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking any command/refresh/settings button returns to the originating page (303), not a JSON blob
CommandPanel, topbar Refresh, and project-settings forms all include returnTo
closedReason: Fixed and verified; merged to main.
